Organization /PSU/Public Listed Compan y over the last three financial years as under: (i) Should have completed three similar services costing not less than the amount e qual to 40% (Forty percent) of the estimated Bid value. or (ii) Should have completed two similar completed services costing not less than the a mount equal to 50% (Fifty percent) of the estimated Bid value. or (iii) Should have completed one similar completed service costing not less than the a mount equal to 80% (Eighty percent) of the estimated Bid value. Note: (i) For fulfilling the criteria of turnover and past experience of similar services a ny one of the following documents submitted by Bidder will be considered. (a) Contract copy along with Invoice (s) with self-certification by the Bidder tha t Service / Supplies against the invoices have been executed. (b) Execution certificate by client / Buyer with contract value. (c) Any other document in support of the contract execution like third party Inspection release note etc. (ii) In case any Bidder is seeking exemption from Turnover / Past Experience crit eria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded in the Bid documents for qualification in the Bid. 3. BID SECURITY DECLARATION: Bidder has to submit Bid security declaration, stati

ng that the Bidder will not withdraw or modify their Bid during Bid validity period as specified by GeM. If withdraw, the Bidder (Firm) will be disqualified & suspended by GeM authority. The format for undertaking is enclosed at Appx ‘A’ of this ATC for r eference. 4. BIDDER FINANCIAL STANDING: 4.1 Net worth of the Bidder (Firm) should be positive as per latest audited financial statement. 4.2 The Bidder (Firm) should not be under Liquidation, Court Receivership or similar proceedings & should not be Bankrupt. Bidder has to submit undertaking for the same as per format enclosed at Appx ‘B’ of this ATC for reference. 5. Forfeiture of Performance Security: Buyer will have the option to forfeit the Perf ormance Security / PBG of the vendor for the services supplied with delay. In case th e contractor / vendor fails to fulfill or defaults on any contractual obligations as mut ually agreed upon, forfeiture of PBG, in part or in full, may be made on the orders of the CFA depending upon the merit of the case. This shall be without prejudice to an y other actions that may be invoked against defaulting contractor / vendor, as dee med fit by competent authority. 6. SERVICE PROVIDERS (VENDOR) OBLIGATIONS / LIABILITIES FOR PAYMENT, WAGES & ALLOWNCES OF MANPOWER DEPLOYED:- 7.1 It is the responsibility of the vendor to pay wages & allowances first i.e. on their own directly only to Aadhar linked Bank Account of the deployed manpower on or before 10th (Tenth) day of every succeeding month through ECS only . Post payment to the manpower vendor has to submit the Invoice Bill and all as sociated documents to Buyer for payment. 7.2 EPF contribution: Maximum EPF contribution of employer should not exceed Rs.3 000/- per month as per EPF Rule. EPF as actual for less than Rs.3000/- to be @ 1 2 % of basic wage or whichever is Lower. 7.3 EPF administration charges & EDLI: Maximum EPF administration charges & EDLI contribution of employer should not exceed Rs.125/- each (Total Rs.250/-) per month respectively as per EPF Rule. 7.4 Payment of Bonus: Refer Payment of Bonus Act 1965 amended in 2015. As pe r this act Bonus is applicable only if the numbers of employees of the service pro vider (Contractor) are more than 20 or more. In this regard it is requested to fur nish a certificate stating that the service provider (Contractor) employs more th

an 20 persons in total. 7.5 MONTHLY BILLING / PAYMENT CYCLE: It is the responsibility of the vendor to submit monthly ‘Invoice Bills’ with all associated documents i.e. Attendance S heet of Firm, GST, EPF, ESIC & Professional tax paid contribution receip t, Service Feedback Form & Bank Statement showing that salary of dep loyed manpower is credited in Aadhar linked bank accounts latest by 1 0th of the every succeeding month for timely payment by PCDA (R & D) thro ugh AO, VRDE, Ahilyanagar. Any delay in submission of said documents or due t o deficient or incorrect documents, the onus rests on Vendor for delay in payme nt. An undertaking for acceptance of this clause should be submitted by the suc cessful L-1 Bidder / Vendor to this office before commencing of contract. 7.6 The payment will be made to the firm as per the Invoice Bills submitted by the v endor and accepted by Buyer. Under no circumstances vendor can stop paymen ts of wages & allowances of deployed manpower on account of delay in clearanc e of bill by paying agency i.e. PCDA (R & D) through AO, VRDE, Ahilyanagar. 7.7 The vendor has to submit undertaking regarding payment to the deployed man power by 10th of every succeeding month as per format enclosed at Appx ‘C’ fo r reference. 8. per prescribed time and before leaving they will report to the officer / Security-i n-charge. If any personnel absent without any intimation then the vendor should provide immediate replacement of absent personnel. 8.6 The contract for outsourcing of 04 x MTS (Security) at CQA (V), Ahilyanagar will be for one year (312 days) i.e. Six days a week. The vendor should provide week ly off to the manpower as per policy in vogue and provide suitable relief on the d ay of weekly off. 8.7 It is the responsibility of the vendor to provide Transportation, Food, Medical etc . to the manpower deployed. This office will not take any liability in this regard. 8.8 This office has full rights to dismiss or remove any outsourced manpower who m ay be incompetent for his/her/their misconduct or if unable to cope with the task assigned. 8.9 The vendor will immediately replace any of its personnel if they are unacceptabl e to this office because of security risk, incompetence, conflict of interest, any br each of confidentiality or improper conduct upon receiving written notice from t his office and provide suitable manpower within 24 hrs. 8.10 The outsourced employees will not be involved in any financial activities using Govt. resources beyond the mandated contractual work in an individual or collec tive capacity in the premises of this Controllerate during official working hours. Govt. resources will not be used for financial activities beyond working hours. 9. The services provided by the vendor should be found satisfactory. If not, then action will be taken as per the ‘Terms& Conditions including ATC’ of the GeM contract. 10.
